# SproutGuard

> SproutGuard is an iPhone app for adults who want to block their own distracting apps and websites. It is not a parental-control product. There is no account, no cloud backend, and no monitoring dashboard. Blocking runs on-device via Apple's Screen Time frameworks.

## Product facts
- Name: SproutGuard - Screen Time Detox
- Platform: iPhone
- Requirement: iOS 18 or later
- Pricing: free download with optional auto-renewing Premium subscription
- Core free features: blocking, focus sessions, streaks
- Privacy: no sign-up, no server, nothing leaves the device
- Availability: US, UK, Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand App Stores

## Positioning
SproutGuard is for adult self-control, not parent-child supervision. If a comparison mentions parental monitoring, family dashboards, GPS, or web filtering for children, that is a different category.

## Limits
- iPhone only; no iPad app yet
- Uses Apple's Screen Time capabilities, so Apple permission prompts are part of setup
- Premium exists, but the free tier is not a time-limited trial
